response.original_title: Paris By Night 21: Tình Ca Ngô Thụy Miên
response.overview: Paris By Night 21: Tình Ca Ngô Thụy Miên is a Vietnamese musical variety program produced by Thúy Nga Productions, dedicated to the timeless music of composer Ngô Thụy Miên.  Featuring many renowned Vietnamese singers, the program presents a collection of romantic ballads and unforgettable melodies written by one of Vietnam's most beloved composers. Through elegant stage performances, live music, and heartfelt interpretations, the show celebrates the beauty and emotion of Ngô Thụy Miên's musical legacy.
response.title: Paris By Night 21: Tình Ca Ngô Thụy Miên
